name: fzf

patches.old:
try_curl() {
  command -v curl > /dev/null &&
    if [[ $1 =~ tar.gz$ ]]; then
      curl -fL $1 | tar $tar_opts
    else
      local temp=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fzf.zip
      curl -fLo "$temp" $1 && unzip -o "$temp" && rm -f "$temp"
    fi
}

try_wget() {
  command -v wget > /dev/null &&
    if [[ $1 =~ tar.gz$ ]]; then
      wget -O - $1 | tar $tar_opts
    else
      local temp=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fzf.zip
      wget -O "$temp" $1 && unzip -o "$temp" && rm -f "$temp"
    fi
}

smoke: printf "alpha\nbeta\n" | "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/fzf" --filter beta | grep -qx beta; test -s "$HOME/.fzf.bash"; bash -n "$HOME/.fzf.bash"
notes: Official installer and complete pinned source tree preserve Bash completion/key bindings and generated initialization. Shell profile editing is disabled with upstream --no-update-rc; source ~/.fzf.bash to enable.
